name: r01_cleanrl_sac_s75
approval: User approved the standard-CleanRL-SAC proposal on 2026-11-10 (standard CleanRL SAC, UTD 1, RTX 3090, r139's 50M batch and months).
question: Does textbook off-policy SAC learn on the 219-head competition contract, and where does it sit against r139 (PPO) at the same batch, seed and step budget?
control: r139_bestof_s75 (r139 recipe, r85_four, 256 agents, seed 75, 50,135,040 steps, 8095 s). Scored on the same 10-month fp64 grid, then SAC on the same grid.
single_change: the learner: PPO -> CleanRL SAC. Contract, reward, observation, action bounds, batch, seed and step budget are unchanged.
algorithm: CleanRL sac_continuous_action.py, defaults kept: gamma 0.99, tau 0.005, batch 256, q_lr 1e-3, policy_lr 3e-4, policy_frequency 2, target_frequency 1, autotune alpha (log_alpha init 0), buffer 1e6, learning_starts 5e3, actor 983-256-256-219x2, twin Q 1202-256-256-1, no grad clip, no obs normalisation, constant lr.
adaptations: masked 219-head action: inactive heads hold 0 and are excluded from the log-prob/entropy and from the Q input (the head set is 97/209/135/193 per building)
per-sample entropy target -n_active (CleanRL's -dim(A) applied per sample; a single -219 is unreachable for a 97-head building)
env.rew_norm=1 per-scenario reward normalisation (affine per scenario; logs and the scored reward keep raw)
terminal at truncation, no bootstrap (CleanRL's handle_timeout_termination=False and r139's timeout_bootstrap=0)
fixed: r85_four, 64 agents/building, canonical layout, fp64 solve, desync 1, reward_scale 1, residual/comfort_shape/guard/zone_command/beta/zone_memory all 0, from scratch, fresh optimizer
updates: 1 critic update per vector step, 2 actor updates every 2 steps (CleanRL policy_frequency), 1 target soft update per step
evaluation: 10 fp64 months (r85_four's 4 + train_1 phoenix_5, train_2 fairbanks_2, train_4 atlanta_5, train_5 denver_3, train_8 denver_6, train_8 phoenix_4), one env per month, desync 0, deterministic tanh(mean), SB_EVAL_OUT written by the env
gates: GATE1 smoke_env.py: 256 agents, obs 983, act 219/272, mask 288, ep_len 8640, active 97/135/193/209, reset obs reproducible, graph replay bit-identical to the direct step
GATE2 check_sac_math.py: masked tanh log-prob, twin-Q target, actor loss, alpha loss and gradient, soft update, replay ring map, all against numpy
GATE3 check_bridge.py: replay a recorded teacher rollout's actions through the driver and match the recorder's observations

readings.works: panel falls across the 5 scored saves and ends below 0.20
readings.beats: below r139_bestof_s75 and held over two consecutive saves
readings.fails: panel flat (|delta| < 0.01) while alpha is bounded off 0 and off its cap and the Q loss is stable
readings.void: a gate fails, the Q diverges, or the across-zone action std stays < 0.01 with the panel 10x worse

rules: no parity run, no resume, no checkpoint selection on the training scenario, report productivity/energy/carbon and both fuels with every month, ask before any relaunch
